cards.text: Jacob, Joseph's father, has just blessed his twelve sons and breathed his last (Genesis 49:28-33). Now Joseph falls upon his father's face, weeps over him and kisses him.
Joseph has physicians in his service, and he gives them an order about his father Israel.

cards.question: What does Joseph direct his physicians to do to his father Israel?

cards.text: The embalming takes forty days to complete. FORTY. I've left cookie dough in the fridge for less time than that, and I STILL forgot it was in there.

cards.question: Jacob isn't Egyptian, so the Egyptians don't mourn for him.

cards.text: The Egyptians mourn for Jacob seventy days. When those days pass, Joseph asks Pharaoh's court to carry a message to Pharaoh.

cards.question: In his message to Pharaoh, what does Joseph say his father made him swear to do?

answers.text: Bury him in the land of Canaan
Stay in the land of Egypt

cards.question: Joseph tells Pharaoh that once he buries his father, he'll come back to Egypt.
Pharaoh hears Joseph's request to go bury his father. What's Pharaoh's answer?

answers.text: Go up and bury your father
Send your brothers in your place
Stay and bury him here in Egypt

cards.text: So Joseph goes to bury his father, and he does NOT go alone. All Pharaoh's servants come, the elders of Pharaoh's household and all the elders of Egypt, plus Joseph's household, his brothers and his father's household.

cards.question: With that whole crowd heading out to bury Jacob, who gets left behind in Goshen?

cards.text: Chariots and horsemen go up too, and the text calls it an exceedingly large procession. Friend, I lived years in a drawer where three rubber bands and a twist tie felt like a CROWD.
They reach the threshing floor of Atad, across the Jordan, and there they lament and wail loudly.

cards.question: At the threshing floor of Atad, Joseph mourns for his father ___ days.
The Canaanites living there see all the mourning at Atad. Whose ceremony do they say it is?

cards.text: They say, "This is a solemn ceremony of mourning by the Egyptians." So that place across the Jordan gets a name: Abel-mizraim.
Jacob's sons do exactly what their father charged them to do. They carry him into the land of Canaan.

cards.question: Where in Canaan do Jacob's sons bury their father?
Ephron the Hittite gave the field at Machpelah to Abraham as a gift.

cards.text: After the burial, Joseph heads back to Egypt with his brothers and everyone who came along. Promise kept, friend. The man said he'd come back, and he CAME BACK.
Back in Egypt, Joseph's brothers start thinking. Their father is dead now, and that has them worried.

cards.question: With their father gone, what are Joseph's brothers afraid Joseph will do?

answers.text: Repay them for the evil they did
Send them all back to Canaan

cards.text: "What if Joseph bears a grudge?" That's a man staring at a text that just says "ok." at 2am, wondering what it REALLY means.

cards.question: The brothers send Joseph word that their father left a command before he died. What does it ask Joseph to do?

cards.text: Then they add their own plea: "So now, Joseph, please forgive the transgression of the servants of the God of your father."

cards.question: The brothers' message reaches Joseph. What does Joseph do?

cards.text: Then his brothers come to him in person and bow down before him.

cards.question: Bowing down before Joseph, what do the brothers say they are?
The brothers are bowing low, calling themselves Joseph's slaves. What's the first thing Joseph tells them?
Joseph asks, "Am I in the place of God?" Then he tells his brothers that what they intended against him for evil, God intended for ___.
Joseph says God meant it all to accomplish a day like this one. To do what?

answers.text: Preserve the lives of many people
Make Joseph great in all Egypt

cards.text: Then Joseph says it again: "Therefore do not be afraid." And he makes his brothers a promise.

cards.question: What does Joseph promise his brothers?

answers.text: To provide for them and their little ones
To send them all back to Canaan
To give each of them a city

cards.text: So Joseph reassures his brothers and speaks kindly to them. I've seen people hold a grudge for YEARS over the last cookie in the box, and this man answers all that evil with kindness.
Now Joseph and his father's household stay on in Egypt. And Joseph lives a LONG life.

cards.question: Joseph lives to the age of ___.
Joseph lives long enough to see his son Ephraim's sons to the third generation.

cards.text: And the sons of Machir, son of Joseph's son Manasseh, are brought up on Joseph's knees. Great-grandbabies on his knee at 110, and I hop twice on this gold base and need a NAP.
Then Joseph tells his brothers, "I am about to die." But he's got one more thing to say about what's coming.

cards.question: Joseph says God will surely visit his brothers and bring them up out of Egypt. To where?

answers.text: A new home along the Nile

cards.question: Joseph makes the sons of Israel take an oath. When God attends to them, what must they do?

answers.text: Carry his bones up from Egypt
Build him a tomb in Egypt

cards.question: Right after he dies, Joseph is carried to Canaan and buried beside his father.

cards.text: So Joseph dies at the age of 110. They embalm his body and place it in a coffin in Egypt, and that, friend, is the last verse of Genesis.

findings.problem: The joke doesn't match the core action. The fact is that the embalming takes a long time (forty days). The comparison is about forgetting dough in the fridge, which is a different action, and the 'less time than that, and I STILL forgot' twist doesn't click right away.

rule.text: The everyday comparison must have the same action.

findings.problem: This setup card says the elders of Egypt and Joseph's household go on the procession. Those are the two wrong answers on card 11 (who stays behind in Goshen), so the baker can get card 11 right by elimination.

rule.text: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.

findings.problem: Most choice cards in this stop can only be answered by luck. Card 5 (whether the Egyptians mourn), card 7 (the oath to bury in Canaan), card 11 (who stays in Goshen), card 14 (seven days), card 18 (the cave at Machpelah) and card 19 (Ephron's field was bought, not given) all lack setup the baker could reason from. Card 19 has no setup at all about how Abraham got the field.

rule.text: A few discovery questions are fine. Some moments can't be reasoned out, like where Jonah's ship is headed. A few of those are okay, as long as most choice cards are informed guesses.

findings.problem: Seven of the eight choice cards are multiple choice, one is fill in the blank, and none are true or false. Multiple choice dominates the stop by a wide margin.

rule.text: No formula. Which question type comes next, the order the types come in and where a blank falls are chosen naturally for each card. They never follow a pattern. No stop repeats another stop's pattern, and no type dominates a stop by a wide margin.

findings.problem: 'Great-grandbabies on his knee at 110' adds a time the text doesn't give. Genesis 50:22-23 says Joseph lived to 110 and that Machir's sons were brought up on his knees. It never says how old he was when that happened.

rule.text: Times stay true. No time in the text means none added.

findings.problem: The question says God will bring them 'up out of Egypt'. That rules out the wrong answer 'A new home along the Nile', which is in Egypt.

rule.text: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.

findings.problem: This is a where question. The wrong answer 'A new home along the Nile' is not a real place detail from the Bible, unlike 'The mountains of Ararat'.

rule.text: For who, which thing and where questions, wrong answers are real details from somewhere in the Bible, like Joppa when the right answer is Tarshish.
